items.title: Why did Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 miss its Rs13-billion box-office potential?
items.hook: Why Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 missed its Rs13-billion box-office potential
items.sum: Rajinikanth's blockbuster sequel Jailer 2 has grossed approximately Rs8.12 billion worldwide after 19 days in theatres, becoming the first Tamil film to cross the Rs8-billion global mark. However, veteran distributor Tiruppur Subramaniam revealed that restrictions on early morning screenings and ticket pricing cost the production up to Rs60 million and prevented the film from reaching its Rs13-billion potential. He noted that previous hits like 2.0 and Leo benefited from flexible pricing and early shows, advantages which Jailer 2 lacked. The film is directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Sun Pictures.
